summary.prose: Build the independent authoritative memory store behind the existing durable queue, with atomic effects/receipts, scoped revision and deletion guards, and coherent bounded reads. Native APFS/ext4 crash qualification gates production host wiring; the plan also preserves source trust, error codes, embedding compatibility and verified shutdown. Run focused tests per task, then the complete sweep after all implementation work, while keeping later-story maintenance and integration coverage explicitly pending.

tasks.title: Pin standalone native dependencies and preserve package boundaries
tasks.summary: Declare exact Lance0.40.0/Arrow18.1.0 dependencies in packages/project-memory/package.json and regenerate workspace package-lock.json; preserve fs-ext, public exports and lazy import behavior. Inventory packaged outputs without introducing backend imports. Update packed.test.ts's existing exact dependency assertion in this task; output requirements for not-yet-built modules remain t14.
acceptanceChecks: Package build succeeds with unchanged public exports and Node22 engine contract.
Pinned dependencies resolve in an isolated consumer; importing package does not load native SDK or touch disk.
Existing exact packed dependency check is updated with the manifest, not deferred across unrelated tasks.

tasks.title: Implement strict persisted codecs and embedding profile
tasks.summary: Add approved private store types/codecs and embedding-profile constant; validate discriminated rows, canonical identities, nullable vectors, full lineage/outcomes and explicit model/dimension/normalizationVersion metadata.
acceptanceChecks: Reject missing/extra/invalid fields and envelope/payload disagreements before mutation.
Golden text/Float32 profile tests distinguish semantic normalizer from embedding preprocessing and reject incompatible plan metadata.

tasks.title: Qualify native single-table primitives under crashes
tasks.summary: Build an isolated native qualification harness using real pinned Lance/Arrow, one records table and parent-observed process barriers. Exercise mixed nullable vectors, one-version publication, pinned readers, close/reopen and SIGKILL around commit on APFS/ext4; no production host wiring. Extend .github/workflows/project-memory.yml with narrowly selected SDK/store qualification scopes where required, preserving full/queue modes and separate macOS local execution.
acceptanceChecks: Record exact Node/platform/filesystem/SDK/source fingerprints and observed process-kill outcomes; skipped platforms do not qualify.
Mixed effects/receipt/control must be old or complete at each boundary; any atomicity or profile incompatibility stops for HLD amendment.
Focused Linux qualification records the installed dependency graph and platform proof without automatically running full package/backend suites during task iteration.

tasks.title: Implement owned store initialization and safe reopen
tasks.summary: Add lazy native connection/table management under DirectoryOwnership, durable format intent/ready metadata, root control and profile/UUID validation; preserve recognized interrupted init and reject non-pristine missing/corrupt stores.
acceptanceChecks: Only pristine roots initialize; existing S2 queue-only roots retain every byte and return explicit unavailable status.
Missing/mismatched marker/root/runtime profile refuses before queue recovery; partial native handles close or owner remains held.

tasks.title: Implement plan, reference and lifecycle guards
tasks.summary: Validate bounded immutable CommitPlan provenance, generation/per-target revisions, scope authority, IDs, immutable history, acyclic supersession and full evidence/source relationships.
acceptanceChecks: Allowed/forbidden lifecycle matrix and stale revision tests enforce exact predecessor/current-pointer rules.
Duplicate keys, dangling/cross-scope references, oversized rows and reserved generated kinds fail before native mutation.

tasks.title: Implement the sole atomic writer and uncertain-write fence
tasks.summary: Serialize commits, reconcile exact existing receipts before stale-generation checks, bind queueId on first event, generate receipt/control and publish one standard merge; fence unknown native outcomes until settlement/reconciliation.
acceptanceChecks: One event publishes effects+receipt+generation in one version; exact retry adds no version/effects.
No-effect failed/quarantined/cleanup-pending outcomes have validated semantics; native rejection/timeouts never authorize blind retry or owner release.

tasks.title: Implement authoritative queue receipt and retirement proofs
tasks.summary: Implement unchanged ReceiptVerifier facade and minimal public receipt projection over immutable stored outcomes, with strict retained-frame matching and proof verification after queue recycling.
acceptanceChecks: Retained conflicting retry regression remains enforced for pending/terminal states.
Unavailable/duplicate/malformed authority is never absent; retirement confirms exact retained digests without content leakage or store-to-queue callback.

tasks.title: Implement broad forget barriers and frame eligibility guard
tasks.summary: Add qualified memory/source/subject/session/conversation/project tombstones, queue cutoff/closed-lifecycle guards, bounded source-dependency invalidation and private read-only pre-inference eligibility; commit always rechecks protection.
acceptanceChecks: Unseen IDs from an older pending event cannot reactivate after broad forget; blocked work gets only a no-effect failed proof.
Higher sequence alone cannot resume an old lifecycle; explicit host-authorized new identities are distinct, and old proofs/tombstones remain effective.

tasks.title: Implement bounded coherent read snapshots
tasks.summary: Create distinct pinned reader leases and current/receipt projections with exact scope/epoch/profile/source/tombstone/validity predicates, final freshness validation and bounded work/results; leave ranking/packing/public semantic reads to S5.
acceptanceChecks: A concurrent forget, binding change, generation change or expiry prevents stale content from returning.
Lease/dependency/result limits fail explicitly without truncation, and no native handles escape the private facade.

tasks.title: Prove real queue/store crash and replay integration
tasks.summary: Compose owner, real S2 queue and private store directly in a test harness. Qualify receipt-before-ACK recovery, broad-forget unknown-ID races, exact retries, recycling and uncertain settlement on macOS/APFS and Linux/ext4 before production service wiring.
acceptanceChecks: Require actual SIGKILL and parent-observed acceptance/commit barriers; assert old-or-complete effects and proof/control coherence after recovery.
Both platforms produce passing fingerprinted evidence for all required boundaries; fake proofs and the earlier clean-exit probe do not close this gate.

tasks.title: Implement trusted admission transforms and public error boundaries
tasks.summary: Add pure source/provenance input/output transforms and optional package-private QueueAdmission constructor seam. Execute module hooks and persist outside original HostPolicy catch; preserve unchanged host sanitization, S2 formats and no-hook behavior.
acceptanceChecks: Public-submit integration returns INVALID_REQUEST for protected raw fields and REVISION_CONFLICT for changed retained/terminal identity, with queue bytes unchanged.
Host-thrown same-named errors remain sanitized; source hash/span/time and deterministic retry/attestation tests pass without model calls.

tasks.title: Implement store OwnedWork and rollback lifecycle
tasks.summary: Add the private store lifecycle adapter with admission stop, pending accounting, native/read drain and idempotent close; exercise queue-before-store resource release and every partially opened startup handle.
acceptanceChecks: Queue proof lookups stay available through queue drain/close; two-participant tests prove no lane inversion or false pending zero.
Timeout/cancellation/failed close never releases ownership before native settlement, and startup rollback attempts all allocated resources.

tasks.title: Wire qualified store into the Node service host
tasks.summary: Update host-node composition to owner -> qualified store -> queue with proof facade -> recovery -> service, supply admission transforms and [queue,storeOwnedWork]; update deterministic attesting host fixtures and unsupported capability behavior.
acceptanceChecks: Production composition is enabled only after native/platform gate evidence passes; unsupported hosts/profiles fail explicitly.
Submit remains durable accepted, status reconciles receipts and public context/search/inspect remain NOT_READY until S5; host ports remain usable after close.

tasks.title: Complete isolated tarball and native-absence verification
tasks.summary: Update strict packed.test.ts dependency/output assertions, require intended private modules and test real external Node22 consumers, pure imports, missing fs-ext/Lance bindings, crash/reopen and lifecycle with no backend sources or new public exports.
acceptanceChecks: All existing packed subjects pass with narrow dist/store allowlist and exact dependencies.
Isolated install/consumer uses only packaged resources, exits naturally without leaked handles, and verifies native-open failures preserve ownership safety.

tasks.title: Verify memory/index/queue isolation and record supporting-story gates
tasks.summary: Test real isolated backend index rebuild/reset against committed memory and pending queue events; implement only S3 internal non-destructive cleanup target preflight and overlap/alias/identity refusal. Record S7 host overlap and S9 real cleanup completion scenarios as pending support gates.
acceptanceChecks: Actual index rebuild preserves logical memory/protection/proofs and exact pending event bytes/status; a sentinel alone is insufficient.
Unsafe internal paths fail before destructive action; no S3 reset API, S7 registry implementation or S9 purge/migration is introduced or falsely marked complete.

tasks.title: Measure bounded store resources and latency
tasks.summary: Add reproducible native/JS resource and latency study with approved corpus/safety boundaries, history/tombstones, batches, leases and overflow cases; record dependency footprint and exact hardware/source/profile metadata.
acceptanceChecks: Report p50/p95 open/commit/current, disk/receipt/control bytes, heap and native RSS; validate bounds without changing semantics or silently truncating.
Measurements disclose fixture limits, do not claim production SLO or power-loss proof, and any needed bound/design change is explicit.

tasks.title: Run final sweep and assemble code-review handoff
tasks.summary: After all implementation tasks, run root/package builds, complete package regression and full backend sweep on stable source, archive APFS/ext4 proof/resource/packaging/isolation evidence and map all S3 criteria before independent story code review.
acceptanceChecks: During prior tasks run only relevant tests; now run full sweep once after all tasks, repeating only for changed/failing scope.
Build/coverage/evidence distinguish native platform qualifications and S7/S9-dependent AC29 gates; no fabricated S2 formal completion, full-AC29 pass, review or approval.
Archive final-source APFS/ext4 complete package/crash qualification alongside source/LLD/profile/dependency fingerprints; earlier t3/t10 snapshots alone cannot count as final evidence.
